title: Finance Intern - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
description:
Are you eager to get hands-on with the finances of one of Europe's fastest-growing renewable energy startups?

Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you can drive impact, learn fast, and actually get things done? If you're passionate about finance, operations, and making things run better - this role is for you!

Your Role at Reonic:
As our Finance Intern, you will be working closely with our Finance team on the tasks that keep our business running - from invoice management and expense tracking to data reconciliation and month-end support.

What You'll Do:

- Get hands-on with pre-bookkeeping and support month-end closing processes

- Support KPI reporting and financial tracking to help shape how we plan and grow

- Support invoice management and collections to keep cash flowing

- Take ownership of data cleaning and provide cross-departmental support

- Be hands-on with financial systems, this role can be as technical as you make it

What Makes You a Great Fit:

- Currently studying Finance, Accounting, Business, or something similar

- DATEV experience is a plus - but not required

- You have a can-do, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude

- You take ownership, think proactively, and aren't afraid to ask questions

- Tech-savvy and curious - you actively use AI tools and can give examples of what you've automated or improved

- Structured, proactive, and comfortable in fast-paced environments

- Ideally start as soon as possible

- Located in Berlin

Why Join Us?

- Be part of one of the fastest-growing VC-backed startups in Germany with 3,000+ satisfied B2B customers.

- A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face - we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

- Enjoy opportunities for personal and professional growth.

- Embrace the freedom to innovate and make quick changes in a dynamic team.

- Perks include gym membership, coffee, regular team events, MacBook and more.

- Receive competitive pay.

Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back - we value talent and passion above all.

About Reonic:
At Reonic, we're on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for solar installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3,000+ business customers, we're growing fast - and we need YOU to help us keep up.

title: DE - Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst (new markets) - Hannover
description:
Salonkee kommt nach Hannover und sucht die erste Person im Vertrieb. Du fühlst dich im Sales zu Hause und hast Lust, ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufzubauen? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung - aktuell gibt es kein Team vor Ort.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Eine Führungskraft und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Product Designer
description:
Product Designer

Location: Remote (Must accommodate US East Coast working hours)

ABOUT US

Partnerships drive 30-50% of company revenue, yet most partner teams still run them on spreadsheets, email chains, and CRMs that were never built for partnerships at scale.

EULER is the AI-native PRM for modern partnership teams, built to replace manual work, remove partner friction, and turn partner activity into repeatable revenue and measurable ROI. Our mission: make partner revenue scalable and predictable.

We grew 600% YoY in 2025 and serve industry leaders, consistently winning against legacy solutions. We move fast, build intentionally, and focus on delivering real value.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Product Designer at EULER , you will design the core product experience for two very different users. Partnership managers use EULER to run their programs. Channel partners use it to register deals, access content, complete training, and get paid.

A growing part of that experience is AI. That includes our in-platform agent (PAM), our Slack-accessible agent (POPS), and workflows where AI drafts, recommends, or acts on the user's behalf. You will help define what good AI UX looks like in B2B software: when the agent should act, when it should ask, and how users stay in control.

You will work day to day with Product Managers and Engineers. This is a hands-on IC role. You own features from problem framing through shipped UI.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own end-to-end design for product areas across the partner portal and the admin experience. That covers discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and engineering-ready specs.

• Design AI-driven experiences, including agent interactions, suggested actions, generated content, and the states around them (loading, uncertainty, errors, human review).

• Simplify complex B2B workflows such as deal registration, referrals, incentives and payouts, onboarding flows, and partner analytics.

• Contribute to and use EULER 's Figma design system, including components, tokens, and variables that keep the product consistent as we ship.

• Run lightweight research and usability tests with customers and partners, and turn findings into concrete design changes.

• Prototype quickly in Figma and Claude Design to test ideas with users before they reach engineering.

• Work closely with engineers during build and review implemented UI against spec.

• Track how your work performs after launch, including adoption, task completion, and drop-off, and iterate based on what you learn.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 4+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS.

• A portfolio showing end-to-end product work on complex workflows, not only visual polish. A portfolio is required to be considered.

• Experience designing for more than one user type, with different goals and mental models.

• Strong Figma skills: auto layout, components, variants, variables, and prototyping.

• Comfortable using AI design tools such as Claude Design to explore and prototype faster without lowering quality.

• Hands-on experience designing AI features, or a clear, well-argued point of view on how AI should show up in product UX.

• Comfortable running research and usability tests yourself.

• Clear written communication. You can explain a design decision in a short async message.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and decisions made with incomplete information.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with PRM, CRM, marketplaces, or other multi-sided platforms.

• Familiarity with low-code builders such as Bubble.io, or an understanding of how design constraints change in them.

• Experience with conversational interfaces or Slack app design.

• Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, React) or experience prototyping with AI coding tools.

WHAT WILL NOT WORK HERE

• Waiting for a perfect brief or complete requirements before starting.

• Handing off designs and disappearing before they ship.

• Must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

• Must be returning to school at the end of the internship to continue academic studies for at least one quarter or semester.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Ability to complete a 12-week in-person internship in one of our offices in summer 2027.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior internship experience and/or leadership on a collegiate project team or laboratory.

• Demonstrated hands-on fabrication skills.

• Exposure to test plan development, test data acquisition, data analysis, and failure analysis techniques

• Exposure to reliability analysis techniques, such as FMEA/FMECA, predictive modeling, Weibull analysis, and Fault Tree Analysis

We're looking for bold thinkers, builders, technologists, and sellers who want real ownership of their work, thrive in collaborative environments, and are energized by solving complex challenges. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact - fast. Data Accuracy & Documentation

Issue Identification & Escalation

• Escalate issues to senior team members with clear context and supporting details

Operational Support

• Collaborate with internal teams (Compliance, Operations, Credit, Treasury) to support onboarding activities

• Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies in workflows or systems

Other duties as assigned.
Who you are:
Education

• Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience in business, compliance, or technical fields.
Experience

• 1+ years of experience in operations, onboarding, or financial services (preferred)

• Experience in payments, fintech, or remittance environments is a plus

• Familiarity with workflow tools, CRM systems, or onboarding platforms

Key Skills

• Bilingual fluency required, including professional-level English communication (written and verbal).

• Strong operational judgment and problem-solving skills

• Ability to make decisions within structured guidelines

• High attention to detail and data accuracy

• Ability to manage multiple workflows in a fast-paced environment

• Effective communication and stakeholder coordination skills

• Comfort working with automated systems and interpreting system outputs

title: Risk Manager - Aviation
description:
Turner & Townsend is looking for an Associate Director - Risk Manager to join our growing team. The ideal individual will be an experienced risk professional who has supported large-scale construction projects and complex programs.
Responsibilities

• Prepare and support the delivery of recurring risk reporting and escalation to PMO and program leadership (e.g., PMO Lead, Alliance Director), synthesizing inputs across workstreams to highlight key risks, cross-cutting issues, and decision-relevant insights.

• Prepare concise, decision-focused risk briefings for program leadership and the client, presenting key conclusions, options, and recommended actions alongside the supporting detailed analysis.

• Facilitate risk identification and intake across workstreams, working with technical, construction, and delivery teams to capture complete and actionable risk information.

• Validate risks with the owning workstream lead before they are reported or escalated, documenting the validation source and date to maintain appropriate traceability.

• Maintain and coordinate risk registers across multiple levels of the program, including project-level inputs, NEEDS package-level registers, and program-level risk views.

• Support and guide project teams in effective risk identification, mitigation, and escalation practices, ensuring consistent inputs into risk registers at all applicable levels.

• Develop, document, and maintain clear escalation criteria for site, cross-site, and program-level risks, together with the required risk reporting cadence, within the Risk Management Plan.

• Maintain visibility of threat/opportunity trigger points to facilitate risk cost profiling, timely drawdown of risk budget, or retirement of threats/opportunities.

• Monitor overall risk exposure and assess the remaining risk budget.

• Collaborate with workstream and delivery teams to understand risk ownership, dependencies, and impacts across the program.

• Conduct quantitative cost and schedule risk assessments to inform project contingency levels.

•
Lead delivery of comprehensive cost and schedule risk assessments, including QCRA and QSRA processes .

• Initiate a proactive approach to the review, development, and continuous improvement of risk management services for the client.

• Undertake end-to-end project risk management practices across multiple projects and programs.

• Develop and maintain risk management plans and processes in accordance with client requirements, processes, policies, and frameworks.

• Conduct risk reviews at regular intervals; identify and analyze risks; determine response plans; and ensure project and program risk profiles are appropriately monitored and reported.

• Establish integration of the risk management function within the program and project controls team, with direct touchpoints to cost and schedule management, change control, and reporting.

• Work proactively and collaboratively with program and project controls teams to eliminate redundancies and identify improvement opportunities.

• Coordinate with the Safety Lead to ensure hazards that also represent cost or schedule risks are captured once and managed consistently across risk and safety processes, in alignment with the Safety Management Plan.

• Facilitate the transfer of risk management knowledge within the immediate risk team, the broader project controls team, and the client organization. Knowledge transfer may include informal one-on-one discussions with client stakeholders as well as formal presentations to clients and colleagues.

• Support the identification and communication of risks affecting schedule performance and recovery planning.

• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

title: Technical Lead - Containerized Command & Control
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril Expeditionary Systems (AES) is building AI Factories and Command/Control centers-specialized, high-performance computing centers designed to process petabyte-scale data and convert it into decisions at machine speed from forward operating bases. These are not traditional data centers. They are air-transportable, power-constrained, hardened systems optimized for AI inference at the tactical edge and deeply integrated with Lattice.

We are seeking highly experienced Lead Electrical Architects to play a pivotal role in defining and shaping the electrical architecture for our product lines. These roles will bridge the critical gap between high-level systems concepts and detailed electrical design, ensuring robust, scalable, and manufacturable solutions for our advanced defense systems. You will be instrumental in translating strategic Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) into actionable electrical requirements and architecture that will guide the entire product development lifecycle.

Exact candidate title and leveling to be determined based upon technical acumen, professional experience, leadership ability, and assessed capabilities through the interview process.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the end-to-end architecture of AI Factory tactical data centers and deployable command and control centers

• Conduct architectural trades, balancing performance, manufacturing feasibility, and future scalability.

• Bridge the gap between traditional Systems Engineering and Electrical Engineering by translating high-level CONOPS into detailed electrical requirements, architectures and functional modules.

• Design air-transportable, modular systems (containerized, palletized, vehicle-mounted) that are rapidly deployable and operationally credible

• Build infrastructure optimized for austere and contested environments-extreme temperatures, limited grid power, SCIF-accreditable, electromagnetic hardening

• Work in tight coupling with Lattice and AI/ML teams to ensure physical infrastructure meets mission-critical software requirements

• Partner with defense customers to translate operational requirements and needs into technical architectures

• Lead prototyping, field testing, and operational validation through military exercises and real-world deployments

• Drive systems from concept through production at scale, working across hardware, software, supply chain, and program teams

• Allocate functions to specific electrical modules and subsystems, defining constraints, interfaces, and communications protocols.

• Flow module and subsystem information to PCB design and harnessing teams to guide designs in line with the overarching electrical architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field

• 5+ years of engineering experience designing and deploying electrical products

• Proven ability to think strategically and define the long-term architectural vision for a product line

• Familiarity with embedded systems hardware, including MCUs, CPUs, and FPGAs, and their architectural implications

• Experience with full-cycle ECU/LRU electronics design, including PCBA design through the entire lifecycle

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.

• Assist to Marketing department efforts during events (Hackathons, conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.)

We expect you to have:

• 5 - 10 + years of experience as a cloud solutions architect, system/network engineer, developer or a similar technical role with a focus on cloud computing

• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with IaC and configuration management tools (preferably Terraform/Ansible), Kubernetes, skills of writing code in Python

• Solid understanding of GPU computing practices for ML training and inference workloads, GPU software stack components, including drivers, libraries (e.g. CUDA, OpenCL)

• Excellent communication skills

• Customer-centric mindset

It will be an added bonus if you have:

• Hands-on experience with HPC/ML orchestration frameworks (e.g. Slurm, Kubeflow)

👉 Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:
DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.
Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe , um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis , Ayvens , Tesla , Volkswagen , Hertz , Avis , Europcar und viele weitere.
In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.
Worin besteht ein DriiveMe -Auftrag?
Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

• Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

• Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

• Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

• Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

• Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

• Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

• Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

• Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

• Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

• Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

• Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?
Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.
Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.
Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.
Gesuchtes Profil
Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

• über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

• selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

• zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

• die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

• verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

title: Video Editor -Malayalam

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

•
Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

•
Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

•
Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

•
Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)

•
Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

•
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

•
Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

•
Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform : local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives . We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

title: Sales Representative (Inbound Closer)
description:
Job Title: Sales Representative (Inbound Closer)

Got the Gift of Gab? We know talking on the phone isn't scary to you - it's your favorite part of the job. If you've already got 1-2 years of outbound or closing phone-sales experience under your belt, and you actually like getting someone to say yes, keep reading.

What you'll be doing: You won't be cold-calling strangers off a list. Our client's leads come in warm - merchants who already reached out or were nurtured by the client's own team. Your job is to pick up that warm conversation, understand what the business needs, and close the deal. Then you'll help them through the paperwork (application, banking info, ID docs) and follow up until they're fully set up. You're closing deals and seeing them through - not just dialing.

Why this role is worth your time:

• This is a fintech / merchant-services closing seat

• You'll get real product training from the client plus Yokly 's own sales training - no sink-or-swim

• Growth path for strong performers - we build long-term seats, not one-off gigs

Here's what you're signing up for:

• Independent Contractor role, full-time.

• Graveyard shift: 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM Philippine Time, which lines up with 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM for our US-based clients.

• Saturdays and Sundays are yours. Always.

• Fully remote - work from home, on your own setup.

• Some calls may be in Tagalog depending on which account you're placed on

What we need from you:

• 1-2 years of outbound or closing phone-sales experience - SDR, telesales, appointment-setting-to-close, anything where you've worked a phone and closed

• Excellent spoken English - this is the single biggest thing our client is looking for

• Experience selling merchant services, credit-card processing, payment processing, fintech, or POS systems is a big plus (not required, but it'll stand out)

• Comfortable asking for the deal, not just chatting - if you've got a story about closing something tough, we want to hear it

• A quiet space to work and stable home internet

What happens next: Apply, and we'll walk you through a quick skills check and a short interview - think of it as a chance to show us how you close, not a test to pass or fail. We'll keep you posted at every step. No ghosting, ever.

Ready to turn warm leads into real wins? Apply now. We've got your back the whole way through.

Join Our Team as a Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate 0.2 FTE.

As part of our CDS Ophthalmology team you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

As a CRO Specialist at BRIGHTSCOUT , you will turn our clients' websites into measurable growth engines. • Proven track record of A/B tests that drove measurable conversion improvements (case studies preferred).

• Strong proficiency with GA4 and Google Tag Manager , including event tracking and funnel reports.

• Experience with experimentation platforms (e.g., Optimizely, Convert , or similar) and behavior tools (e.g., Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity ).

• Solid understanding of testing statistics: significance, sample size, and common pitfalls.

• Working knowledge of UX/UI principles and persuasive copywriting for landing pages.

• Comfortable with basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript to build or adjust test variations.

• Strong communication skills, able to turn complex data into clear stories for non-technical stakeholders.

• Organized and able to manage multiple client experiments in parallel.

• Advanced English (written and spoken).

Nice to have

• Experience with CRMs (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio ) to tie conversions to pipeline and lead quality.

• Basic SEO and AEO knowledge, and how testing can affect organic performance and discoverability in LLMs.
